comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: A popular poisonous berry

Obtained in London Adventure Guild.

Requirements: Ecological Research r5, Biology r7, Spanish (I got the quest without the language).

Guide: Talk to Justine in Oxford 3x

Talk to the barkeep in Jamaica 3x

Talk to the Market Keeper once.

Search by the baskets beside the Market Keeper with Ecological Research to find the Ackee berries.
